defaults.video_script: Fifty-four goals. Harry Kane needed eighty-one games to break England's record. Naples, March two thousand and twenty-three. England away at Italy. In December, Kane missed a penalty against France in Qatar. England went out. Kane carried that miss for months. Forty-fourth minute in Naples, Italy concede a penalty. Kane steps up and scores. Fifty-four, one more than Wayne Rooney. England win two-one. Kane has the record. Is Kane the greatest England striker of all time?
defaults.video_subject: In March 2023 in Naples, Harry Kane scored a 44th-minute penalty in England's 2-1 win over Italy for his 54th goal in his 81st cap, passing Wayne Rooney's 53 to become England's all-time top scorer, three months after missing a penalty against France at the World Cup.
